[1mDescription[22m:
Load trace file into a session (start trace_processor_shell) and return
sessionId

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli perf trace load[22m [options] <trace-file>

[1mArguments[22m:
  [1mtrace-file[22m                    Path to trace file (.perfetto-trace)

[1mOptions[22m:
  [1m--shell <path>[22m                Path to trace_processor_shell binary (default:
                                "trace_processor_shell")
  [1m-p, --port <port>[22m             Daemon port (default: "950
